title: Microsoft Purview: auto-labeling ceiling for SharePoint and OneDrive rises to 500,000 files a day (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing, policy controls and documented limits are supported. It correctly distinguishes the 500,000-file ceiling from guaranteed throughput and leaves the increase's activation requirements unstated.

claims.claim: Policy locations are edited in Microsoft Purview portal under Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies > policy > Edit policy > Choose locations where you want to apply the label.
claims.quote: Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies ... select the Edit policy button ... For the page Choose locations where you want to apply the label: Select and specify locations for Exchange, SharePoint, and OneDrive.

claims.claim: Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AddSharePointLocation <site URLs> adds included SharePoint sites when the location is not All.
claims.quote: The AddSharePointLocation parameter specifies the SharePoint sites to add to the list of included sites when you aren't using the value All for the SharePointLocation parameter. You identify the site by its URL value.

claims.claim: The corresponding OneDrive parameter is -AddOneDriveLocation, which adds included sites when the location is not All.
claims.quote: The AddOneDriveLocation parameter specifies the OneDrive sites to add to the list of included sites when you aren't using the value All for the OneDriveLocation parameter. You identify the site by its URL value.

claims.claim: Edit policy is documented for policies in Off or Simulation.
claims.quote: For a policy in the Off section, select the Edit policy button. For policy in the Simulation section, select the Edit policy option at the top of the page, from either tab.

claims.claim: Narrowing a policy's locations does not change the tenant-wide throughput ceiling.
claims.quote: The absolute maximum throughput is 500,000 automatically labeled SharePoint and OneDrive files per tenant per day, in aggregate across all auto-labeling policies.

claims.claim: A policy can be enabled in Microsoft Purview portal under Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies > policy > Turn on policy.
claims.quote: Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies ... Select your policy to see the details ... When you're ready to run the policy without simulation, select the Turn on policy option.

claims.claim: Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Mode Enable enables policy actions and notifications.
claims.quote: The Identity parameter specifies the auto-labeling policy that you want to modify. ... The Mode parameter specifies the action and notification level ... Enable: The policy is enabled for actions and notifications.

claims.claim: TestWithoutNotifications is the simulation or test value for Mode.
claims.quote: TestWithoutNotifications: An audit mode where no actions are taken, and no notifications are sent (Test mode).
